name: PMO delivery competency framework (example, configurable)
note: Example framework for the synthetic organisation. Organisations replace this file with their own job-level framework. Evidence counts show what work has demonstrated; an evidence gap is not a deficiency and may reflect lack of opportunity.

project_delivery.label: Project delivery
project_delivery.description: Milestones achieved within 5% of their baseline interval; closed projects meeting their benefits case.

technical_judgement.label: Technical judgement
technical_judgement.description: Deliverables approved first time on projects assessed at technical complexity 4–5.

ownership.label: Ownership
ownership.description: Blockers resolved within 7 days; external dependencies driven to resolution.

stakeholder_management.label: Stakeholder management
stakeholder_management.description: Stakeholder survey scores of 4–5. Perception-based and known to be noisy; never sufficient on its own.

risk_leadership.label: Risk leadership
risk_leadership.description: Risks identified before impact and mitigated through the RAID process.

strategic_influence.label: Strategic influence
strategic_influence.description: Scope changes taken through formal change control; programme-level milestones delivered. Limited evidence sources in v0.1.

organisational_impact.label: Organisational impact
organisational_impact.description: Cross-unit dependencies resolved; benefits realised at project closure.
